title: Existence of relative divided power envelopes for arbitrary ring-ideal maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Representability requires a solution-set construction, not simply a formal appeal to a free polynomial algebra. The proof constructs a bounded divided-power subalgebra containing all specified images and operations, then verifies compatibility with arbitrary limits to produce the universal envelope.
